title: 普朗克·静港船长
description: 普朗克穿完整海盗长外套站在宽码头，弯刀入鞘、手枪收好，海风和侧光勾出帽檐与浓须。

art_direction.medium: angular wax-crayon strokes, directional hatching and dramatic hard-edged light on textured paper
art_direction.identity: Gangplank is a rugged adult pirate captain with a thick dark beard, weathered face, broad hat, long red-brown coat, and recognizable mechanical arm details. Preserve his fully closed shirt, opaque trousers, heavy boots, and layered belts. His curved cutlass remains sheathed and his pistol sits in a closed holster, with no aiming, smoke, or active weapon handling.
art_direction.scene: He stands at the end of a broad secure dock, one hand on a plain mooring post and the other relaxed beside his coat. A large stationary ship and far harbor wall recede behind him. Strong slanting sunlight catches brass edges and coarse wax-crayon cloth planes, with calm open water and a restrained sky making the captain commanding but peaceful.
art_direction.palette: weathered red, navy sea, leather brown, brass gold
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing

visual_qa.method: up to ten images on a compressed JPEG contact sheet, max edge 1280
